description: A loading placeholder (DESIGN.md, Skeleton): a block of TsuyaColors.fillStrong at the final size of what loads, with the radius of the real element, and a slow opacity pulse that stops under reduced motion. Hidden from screen readers: marking the region that loads as busy is the app's own concern, not the block's.

constructors.description: A block width by height (default: fills its container, one text line tall), radius (default TsuyaRadius.xs).

params.name: width
params.description: Its width, or null to fill the container (the default).

params.name: height
params.description: Its height, or null for one text line (the ambient DefaultTextStyle's size, at the text scale).

constructors.name: text
constructors.description: lines rows at a text line's height (default 3), the last one at 60 % so it reads like a paragraph.

params.name: lines
params.description: How many lines, for Skeleton.text; null for a plain block.
